interpretation: These are bounded application-specific obligations, not a proof that Pipeline is bug-free. Human owners must validate completeness and intended semantics before implementation.

obligations.property: For concurrent writes from the same referral section version, at most one material mutation commits and every loser receives the characterized stale-write result without audit or side effects for an unapplied change.
obligations.claimBoundary: Declared referral section/version commands under the tested local and PostgreSQL configurations.

obligations.property: Each referral command follows its approved replay, conflict, or non-retryable contract; no duplicate applies twice; and every committed material PostgreSQL mutation includes exactly the attributed audit effect in the same transaction.
obligations.claimBoundary: Commands explicitly listed in the owner-approved retry table; local audit differences remain explicit.

obligations.property: After signing, assessment content, signer attribution, and recorded provenance cannot be overwritten; later clinical clarification is append-only and preserves the signed version.
obligations.claimBoundary: All lifecycle commands and historical signed/addendum shapes included in the compatibility fixture set.

obligations.property: Assessment mutations require the approved actor and resource relationship, retain field evidence, and preserve the characterized atomicity or recovery behavior of related referral workflow updates in both adapters.
obligations.claimBoundary: Approved assessment roles, resource relationships, and workflow synchronization commands.

obligations.property: No sequence of approved commands skips a required workflow stage, silently reopens a terminal decision, bypasses role/resource authorization, or creates a second canonical writer.
obligations.claimBoundary: The owner-approved finite workflow model and its executable conformance mapping to production transition functions.

obligations.property: Only a ready, accepted, authorized referral records an EHR handoff outcome; duplicate or stale attempts do not apply twice; failures remain attributable and Pipeline never represents an external send that did not occur.
obligations.claimBoundary: Pipeline-owned handoff state and explicitly modeled external outcomes; no unverified claim about an external EHR.

obligations.property: Original packet bytes and digest remain immutable, and every accepted extracted value retains document, page, bounding box or declared location, confidence, candidates, review, correction, and audit lineage.
obligations.claimBoundary: Governed packet formats and values represented in the approved corpus; individual ambiguous values still require review.

obligations.property: Claims, leases, retries, dead letters, and callbacks remain bounded and stale-attempt safe, while workers are structurally and behaviorally unable to write canonical referral or assessment state directly.
obligations.claimBoundary: Declared worker state machine, internal routes, and tested queue/storage configurations.

obligations.property: Autosave, queued saves, remount, navigation, recovery drafts, and stale-version conflicts cannot silently discard server-accepted or visibly acknowledged user work.
obligations.claimBoundary: Characterized browser states, navigation paths, timing schedules, and supported browsers in the approved matrix.

obligations.property: No name-only or ambiguous candidate can become a canonical resident link without an authorized explicit review; identifier and DOB conflicts block linking; stale or denied attempts create no link.
obligations.claimBoundary: Owner-approved identity inputs, conflict rules, roles, and reviewed-link commands.

obligations.property: Reorganizing tests preserves every approved behavior assertion and cleanup contract, introduces no source-string substitute, and retains a 100 percent kill rate for the reviewed critical mutant set.
obligations.claimBoundary: The owner-approved assertion inventory, journeys, fixtures, cleanup semantics, and certified mutant set.

obligations.property: Shared test helpers cannot swallow failures, weaken user-visible expectations, change isolation, or make a broken critical journey pass through retries or unconditional cleanup.
obligations.claimBoundary: Helpers and journeys included in the approved test-structure slice audit.
